subject: Upcoming Travel Plans
body: Dear Team, I hope this message finds you well. I am excited to inform you about my upcoming travel plans for a conference next month. I will be flying out on the 15th and returning on the 18th. During my absence, I will ensure that all pending tasks are completed before my departure. I will also be available via email for any urgent matters that may arise. Thank you for your understanding and support. Best regards, [Your Name]
